review_notes:
I found no proof reasoning in this file that is repeated and nontrivial enough for this rubric. I read all 107 lines: the `LocalKaehlerField` structure, the four definitions (connection, curvature, logDet, ricciHessian) and the seven lemmas. I also looked at the external lemmas these proofs call: `mderiv_inverse` in MatrixWirtinger.lean, `wderiv_logdet` in MatrixLogDet.lean, `ricci_cancellation_at_one` in KaehlerSecondDerivatives.lean and `closed_dz_symmetry` in KaehlerClosedDerivatives.lean.

Every proof is short and hands its real work to one of those external lemmas, so none of the reasoning is repeated inside this file. The only repeated pieces are routine:
- Turning smoothness on the domain into smoothness at a point, `K.smooth.contDiffAt (K.isOpen.mem_nhds hz)`, which appears in `connection_smooth`, `logDet_smooth`, `curvature_formula` and `ricciHessian_trace`.
- The two-line opening `apply K.isOpen.contDiffOn_iff.mpr; intro z hz`, shared by `connection_smooth` and `logDet_smooth`.
- The non-zero-determinant argument `fun y hy => ne_of_gt (K.positive y hy).det_pos`, used in `inverse_smooth` and `curvature_formula`.

The rubric explicitly excludes routine unfolding and thin wrappers around existing API, which is all a helper for any of these would be. A `det_ne_zero` field lemma would save a few characters but would not factor out any mathematical reasoning, so I did not report it.

The two longer proofs, `ricciHessian_trace` and `curvature_contraction_at_one`, each rest on a different external result (`wderiv_logdet` and `ricci_cancellation_at_one`) and share no reasoning with each other. `curvature_contraction_at_one` already reuses `curvature_formula` rather than repeating it.

Remaining uncertainty: I did not check whether other files in the project repeat these patterns at the level of `LocalKaehlerField`; that question is outside this single-file review.
